def unary(z,pref):
    d={}
    for p in [-2,-1,-0.5,0.5,1,1.5,2,3]:
        d[f'{pref}^{p}']=z**p
    d[f'ln{pref}']=np.log(z)
    d[f'exp{pref}']=np.exp(z)
    d[f'exp-{pref}']=np.exp(-z)
    d[f'sin{pref}']=np.sin(z)
    d[f'cos{pref}']=np.cos(z)
    d[f'tanh{pref}']=np.tanh(z)
    d[f'1/(1+{pref})']=1/(1+z)
    d[f'{pref}exp-{pref}']=z*np.exp(-z)
    d[f'{pref}|{pref}|']=z*np.abs(z)
    d[f'log1p{pref}']=np.log1p(z)
    d[f'1']=np.ones_like(z)
    return d
